limits: Fresh Amazon browser attempt timed out after 60 seconds. Existing same-day exact records retained with original timestamps; no new offer, delivery, seller or condition claim.
Ardo Alyssa Hands-Free remains external motor plus tubing, distinct from Melia. Manufacturer double kit confirmed; Amazon components not exhaustively matched.
Philips SCF495/11 is two in-bra motors, distinct from SCF547/11 external-motor/tubing system. Manufacturer DE kit documented; no Baby+ pump-control claim.
Fizimed Emy Pump exact historical Amazon selection is Single/Standard, not the optional manufacturer Double.
eufy E10 direct EU page and comparison confirm named model, in-bra form and no heating/case; Amazon T8D03 retained. Exact DE-ASIN pump quantity and complete sizes not confirmed.

eufy E20 heated in-bra model supported by EU page and global support; pump-hub attachment corroborated by US FAQ. Three heat levels/USB-C supported; DE ASIN quantity, complete kit and regional code suffix unresolved.
Philips support page lists a July 2026 manual, but PDF not opened. No claim of exhaustive manual/safety validation for any model.
No comparative efficacy, output, comfort, reliability, sensor precision, cleaning-time or unrestricted photo rights established.
All five are named model identities, not proof of physically independent OEM designs. No complete-market claim, no ranking.
integrationNotes: Merge models by exact brand|canonicalModel; do not normalize Philips generations, Ardo families, sets or colors into extra rows.
Append sources preserving source IDs, or consistently rebase all sourceIds, independentCheckSourceIds and originalBatchCitationIds. New range 67–80.
Original dataset model keys and snapshots unchanged; parent owns integration and live-site release.
Parent should regenerate global counts rather than add supplemental brand count, because four of the five rows use existing brands. Only Fizimed is a new brand.
